title: Witness XZ Andromedae Wink
explanation:
# XZ Andromedae: A Cosmic Eclipse

Two stars in the XZ Andromedae system orbit so perfectly edge-on from Earth that we watch them take turns blocking each other's light, creating a telltale dimming-and-brightening pattern that reveals evidence of two additional hidden stars in this complex gravitational dance. Amateur astronomers can now use free software called Citizen Astronomy to detect these subtle brightness changes themselves, a technique that also helps scientists discover distant exoplanets and study explosive cosmic events.
